units: Sot. 11ᵇ זמן מוֹלָדֵיהֶן their time of giving birth; Ex. R. s. 1 מולידיהן (corr. acc.).—מוֹלַד לבנה (or only מ׳) the beginning of the first quarter of the moon, New-Moon.
Pesik. R. s. 15 מ׳ הלבנה היה וכ׳ the New-Moon took place on a Wednesday at noon-time.—*2) travail.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 16b:2">B. Bath. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>מִתְרַפָּה ממוֹלָדָהּ</he> (not <he>מתרפא</he>) she is relieved of her severe throes (differ. vers. in Ms. M., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
